description: Per IW8 asset type: readers, neutral adapters, writers and the gates of PLAN-neutral-assets.md. G1 source ownership, G2 normalization, G3 dependency closure, G4 native serialization readback, G5 Replay Load/Preload acceptance. record_identical: dumpzone of the stock zone and of the zone rebuilt from neutral data give equal files (tools/compare_dump_trees.py). source_layout: the type round-trips as its IW8D record graph (IW8_REWRITE=dump: dump, parse, write, load, dump again to the same records), the fallback for types without a neutral schema (not normalized). Update a row when its evidence unit records the gate.
